title: The Logotype: Grid Drawing for Large Applications
slide_intent: Teach designers to enlarge a mark without losing the relationships between curves and strokes. Small changes to a letterform become conspicuous at sign scale.
strategic_value: NASA can maintain the identity when a large surface requires a constructed master. The square grid gives a fabricator a repeatable geometric reference.
demonstration: The landscape sheet enlarges the black master across a square grid. The accompanying text sets the vertical stroke width at three grid units.
practical_value: Use the grid for a large application when photographic reproduction is impractical. Check stroke width, proportions and curves against the drawing.

content_islands.name: Construction guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the title, explanation and contact guidance in a narrow upper band.

content_islands.name: Gridded master
content_islands.spec: Run the gridded field across the lower page, keeping the entire black logotype and several open grid cells around it visible.
